description: Reads test files and says, per test, whether a change to the code could break them: which compare no value, which leave an expectation unfinished, which compare something with itself, which catch and discard their own failure, and which never run. Where the checking happens in a helper it cannot follow it says so instead of accusing. Costs nothing and uses no model. Use it on tests that were just written - including tests you wrote yourself - before claiming a change is covered.

paths.description: Paths inside the project to read, relative to it. Defaults to the whole project.

project.description: Absolute path of the project folder

name: vouch_tests
title: Could these tests ever fail?
